BSL native FXAA=true makes composite6 real AA work, so omitting it would violate the native-AA requirement. Other possible copy-only branches (including MOTION_BLUR=false composite2) lack a complete physical bank/alpha/history certificate; composite3/5/7 also update temporal data. No certified reusable omission was found.

Both MakeUp native mip families have positive-LOD consumers: colortex1 exposure in the vertex path at log2(min(viewWidth,viewHeight))-1, and colortex0 soft-LOD bloom. At native4K these are not dead chains. No omission is justified while preserving the present settings.

Its material/lighting/translucency graph has no certified equivalent zero-work predicate in the current implementation. Defer a new pack-specific algorithm; this is not measured zero or a missing NVIDIA capability.

The present BSL volume_light_reuse route has no operative qualified native consumer. The historical Balanced clear-weather cloud-bound prototype has different source/profile/API conditions and cannot substitute for this native tuple.

This MakeUp profile has no native material POM traversal or height-map consumer. A parallax-cache request therefore cannot remove native POM work here. The other families use separately measured native-PBR cases.

BSL native bloom uses a6x6 grid of distinct offsets. At4K these are nonzero distinct pixel offsets, so the MakeUp identical-coordinate reuse certificate does not port. Approximate bilinear pairing/clamp/derivative changes would be a different implementation needing quality proof; no universal impossibility is claimed.

MakeUp native composite writes multiple outputs (including full scene color); composite1 combines scene and bloom. The measured single-output bloom VRS contract would coarsen additional scene work here. A new isolated producer/quality contract is required; this is not an absent NVIDIA VRS capability.
